tasks.subject: Task 0: The anchor view
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One parser for anchor attributes, with two editors, that declines to touch damaged tags.

**Files:**
- Create: `admin/pipeline/transform/links.ts`
- Test: `admin/pipeline/transform/links.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] anchors(tokenize(s)) returns one Anchor per <a> with href, dataRef, display and token span
- [ ] An anchor whose opening tag fails opensScope is returned malformed: true and both editors refuse it
- [ ] serialize(retarget(...)) and serialize(unlink(...)) round-trip every untouched byte
- [ ] unlink removes exactly the two tag tokens and keeps every text token between them
- [ ] No regex parses an attribute outside this file

**Verify:** `bun test admin/pipeline/transform/links.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/transform/links.ts", "admin/pipeline/transform/links.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/transform/links.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Anchor exposes href, dataRef, display, span", "malformed anchors refused by both editors", "byte round-trip preserved", "unlink keeps display text", "attribute parsing lives only in links.ts"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 11: Compose, write back, close the batch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the rules do not undo each other, make every catalogue row true, and leave the docs matching what shipped.

**Files:**
- Create: `admin/pipeline/transform/registry.order.test.ts`
- Modify: `data/patches/patterns.jsonl`
- Modify: `docs/specs/2026-08-22-transform-module-design.md` (§7 table)
- Modify: `docs/v2/phase-2-triage.md`
- Create: `docs/v2/transform-batch-2.md` (the batch report)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A composed corpus pass runs EVERY registered rule in registry order over all 32,512 entries with zero gate failures
- [ ] Per-rule composed counts are compared against the isolated transform:count numbers; every difference is explained in the batch report
- [ ] registry.order.test.ts asserts unlink rules precede compose rules and entangled rows are adjacent
- [ ] bun body:migrate-dry reports 32,512/32,512 on all four round-trip gates, 0 schema failures, 0 quarantines, 0 repair failures, 0 transform failures
- [ ] Every touched row has a true reason and a corpusCount whose unit is stated, whose population corrections are written back, and whose declines are documented where the rule fires on fewer than it counts; reclassified rows have route changed and are out of PENDING (amended 2026-08-24 after review: ib-yoma-2a counts 312 occurrences and fires on 188 entries, sifre-ib-resolves-to-yalkut has 1 fire and 5 reasoned declines, so 'reproduces' was never literally true and forcing it would mean loosening a predicate to hit a number)
- [ ] The module spec §7 table records batch 2 as shipped with the deferred rows named
- [ ] docs/v2/phase-2-triage.md totals are recomputed from the catalogue, not hand-edited

**Verify:** `bun qa && bun transform:count && bun body:migrate-dry`

